company.name: GrowthBook
company.shortDescription: GrowthBook is an open source feature flagging and experimentation platform
company.description: Growth Book is an open source feature flagging and A/B testing platform that helps companies make better data-driven product decisions. Our platform gives any company the power of a customized deployment and A/B testing solution like those used by AirBnB, Netflix, Uber, etc. without having to build it. Used in production by thousands of companies globally.

productsAndServices.description: A system to create, manage, and control feature flags for software deployment, enabling targeted releases and codebase management.

productsAndServices.description: A platform to design, run, and analyze A/B tests using existing data sources for continuous product improvement.
productsAndServices.name: A/B Testing (Experimentation)

productsAndServices.description: Integration with existing data warehouses and event tracking systems to use current data for feature flagging and experimentation.
productsAndServices.name: Data Warehouse Native Integration

productsAndServices.description: An open source platform for feature flagging and experimentation that can be self-hosted for full control and security.
productsAndServices.name: Open Source Platform and Self-hosting

productsAndServices.description: Open source SDKs and APIs for multiple programming languages to integrate feature flags and experiments with applications.
productsAndServices.name: Lightweight SDKs and APIs

productsAndServices.description: A visual tool that allows users to run A/B tests and make website changes without coding or engineering support.
productsAndServices.name: Visual Editor for No-code Website Experimentation

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $22,621,791, or 97.84% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,006,114 to $101,454,180, a 11.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 89 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 81 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
